#  11745 - Power Generation from Bio Fuels Modulübersicht  
|  Module Number:   | **11745 - module is no longer offered from SS 2023**  |  
| --- | --- |  
| Module Title:  | **Power Generation from Bio Fuels**  |  
|  Energieerzeugung durch Biotreibstoff   |  
| Department:  |  Faculty 3 - Mechanical Engineering, Electrical and Energy Systems   |  
| Responsible Staff Member:  | 
  * Prof. Dr.-Ing. Schwarz, Harald 

 |  
| Language of Teaching / Examination:  | English  |  
| Duration:  | 1 semester  |  
| Frequency of Offer:  |  Every summer semester   |  
| Credits:  |  
| Learning Outcome:  | The students acquire knowledge of basics of power generation from bio fuels and operation of plants for thermal use of biomass. Thus, students are able to perform location-specific studies and have the posibility to visit the facilities designed to generate energy from bio fuels.  |  
| Contents:  | Properties, emissions and greenhouse gas reduction potential of biofuels, theory of energy conversion of the various conversion processes, thermal (pyrolysis / gasification) and biological (fermentation) processing into gaseous fuels, combustion technologies for solid biomass (wood, straw), vegetable oil used in internal combustion engines (CHP) system concepts , design and calculation methods, practical knowledge through demonstration of power generation from bio fuels.  |  
| Recommended Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Mandatory Prerequisites:  | None  |  
| Forms of Teaching and Proportion:  | 
  * Lecture / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Seminar / 2 Hours per Week per Semester 
  * Self organised studies / 120 Hours 

 |  
| Teaching Materials and Literature:  | 
  * Flaig, H., Mohr, H.: Energie aus Biomassen, Springer Verlag 1993
  * T. Bohn :Nutzung regenerativer Energie Handbuchreihe ENERGIE; Band 13, Technischer Verlag Resch; Verlag TÜV Rheinland, Gräfeling, 1988
  * Lecture scripts

 |  
| Module Examination:  | Final Module Examination (MAP)  |  
| Assessment Mode for Module Examination:  | 
  * Written examination, 90 minutes **OR**
  * Oral examination, 45 minutes

In the first lecture it will be announced, if the examination will be offered in written or oral form.  |  
| Evaluation of Module Examination:  | Performance Verification – graded  |  
| Limited Number of Participants:  | 45  |  
| Part of the Study Programme:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Remarks:  | No more offers from the summer-semester 2023 .  |  
| Module Components:  | 
  * Power Generation from Bio Fuels (lecture/seminar)

 |  
| Components to be offered in the Current Semester:  | 
  * no assignment

 |  
| Follow-up Module/s:  |  Phase-out module since: 23.01.2023 
  * without Follow-up Module/s

 |
